section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The headquarters of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) is located in:
explanation: UNESCO is headquartered in Paris. The main UN headquarters is in New York; the WHO and ILO are based in Geneva; the FAO is headquartered in Rome.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India is primarily responsible for:

options.option_text: Auditing the accounts of the Union and State governments
Conducting elections to Parliament and State Legislatures
Recruiting civil servants through competitive examinations
Setting monetary policy and interest rates

explanation: The CAG (Article 148) audits government accounts and reports to the legislature on public expenditure. Elections are the Election Commission's job; recruitment is UPSC's; monetary policy is the RBI's.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The United Nations' 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development comprises how many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?
explanation: The 2030 Agenda, adopted in 2015, comprises 17 SDGs (covering poverty, health, education, climate, etc.), succeeding the earlier 8 Millennium Development Goals (MDGs, 2000-2015).

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Chandrayaan-3, which achieved a historic soft landing near the Moon's south pole in August 2023, made India the:

options.option_text: First country to land near the lunar south pole
First country to land anywhere on the Moon
First country to send a human to the Moon
First country to launch a satellite into space

explanation: Chandrayaan-3 made India the first nation to soft-land specifically near the Moon's south pole, and the fourth (after USSR, USA, China) to achieve any soft lunar landing — not the first Moon landing overall, nor a crewed mission.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: India hosted the G20 Summit, a major gathering of the world's major economies, in the year:
explanation: India held the G20 Presidency and hosted the New Delhi Summit in September 2023, adopting the New Delhi Leaders' Declaration.
